sentence: This project studies how visible light and tiny particles of gold and ruthenium could help make ammonia under gentler conditions.
This project studies why reptiles living on islands have become smaller and reproduce differently from reptiles of the same species on the mainland.
This project builds a system that uses smartphone foot scanning and a fit survey to make shoes that fit each person.
This project supports a conference where researchers share their work on electric power and energy systems.
This project studies how chromatin, the packed form of DNA, changes and moves as T cells become active and specialized.
This project studies how bacteria that use methane as a source of carbon and energy process carbon.
This project tries to find out how spiking neural networks can efficiently handle long-range dependencies and generative tasks on small devices.
This project engineers enzymes that can break the strong carbon-fluorine bonds found in chemicals that persist in the environment.
This project studies stochastic dynamical systems and designs algorithms for machine learning and option pricing in finance.
This project builds perception systems for robots and self-driving cars that adapt to the routes and weather where each person uses them.
This project sets up ways to collect and share field data on how ground and infrastructure perform after disasters such as earthquakes and floods.
This project builds a breast and skin tissue model on a chip with blood and lymphatic vessels to study how cancer spreads.
This project builds a tool that reads complex medical records to pull out useful information and assess patient risk.
This project builds neural field methods that create and compress visualization images of complex scientific data.
